method: SCOPE §4.2 sections fetched from uscode.house.gov (prelim edition; 26 U.S.C. 71/215 from 2017 edition as last text in force). Very long sections split at the subdivision named in SCOPE (e.g. 8 U.S.C. 1101(b), 11 U.S.C. 523(a)(5)). D(norm) = enactment date of the latest amending Public Law in the source credit (section-level) or latest Public Law whose Amendments note targets the subdivision (subdivision-level; amendments to introductory/flush language excluded).
gaps: 22 U.S.C. 9102: no section found at uscode.house.gov (omitted)
22 U.S.C. 9103: no section found at uscode.house.gov (omitted)
FRCP 4(f) (Hague Service implementation) not included — rules of court are not in the U.S. Code sections fetched; to add from uscourts.gov
Amendment effective dates that differ from enactment dates (e.g. BAPCPA 2005 effective 2005-10-17) are not modelled — enactment date used as D(norm)
